titolo: NVIDIA Deploys AI Factory Operations Agent on DGX H100, B200, GB300 Clusters
descr: NVIDIA announced an AI Factory Operations Agent that runs on‑premises across its DGX H100, DGX B200, and DGX GB300 production clusters.
paragrafi: NVIDIA announced an AI Factory Operations Agent that runs on‑premises across its DGX H100, DGX B200, and DGX GB300 production clusters.
The agent follows the NemoClaw blueprint, uses OpenShell for sandboxed execution, and relies on locally served Nemotron open models for inference.
Specialized sub‑agents cover domains such as Job Recovery, Hardware, Observability, Research, Kubernetes, and Cluster Management, communicating via the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
Users interact through a chat interface that routes queries to the appropriate domain agent, presenting recommendations and audit trails for site reliability engineers.
The framework is deployed as a Kubernetes control‑plane application with Helm, and enforces security through read‑only credentials, RBAC, and per‑session sandboxing.
perche: For AI operators, the agent promises faster fault diagnosis and reduced manual effort by consolidating multi‑layer data into a single chat view. For developers of free or locally hosted models, the on‑premises design showcases a path to build similar agent ecosystems without relying on cloud services.
